<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Grade a receipt line and decide its disposition"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/receipts/{receiptId}/lines/{lineNo}/inspections"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records the inspection grade of one receipt line and runs
`DecideDisposition` in the same transaction. `quantity` is required
and must be in `[1, received quantity]` (400 `invalid-quantity` when
absent or below 1, 409 `inspected-exceeds-received` above the received
quantity); an inspection of fewer units than were received still
closes the line, because a line is inspected exactly once (409
`line-already-inspected`). 404 `receipt-not-found` answers an unknown
receipt and a receipt with no such line; it also answers the call
when no disposition policy was ever declared. Publishes
`ReturnLineInspected` and `DispositionDecided`; a RESTOCK outcome
additionally publishes `ReturnLineStaged`. Requires an
`Idempotency-Key`.
